known_fixes: Container validation was blocked because the private @tiptap-pro package registry returned HTTP 403 without credentials.
discovery_notes: ResearchHub web is a Next.js 15 App Router frontend using npm and package-lock.json. It serves on port 3000 with npm run dev and reads its backend from NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL when supplied; no local database or cache service is declared. The first Docker validation could not install private @tiptap-pro dependencies because no registry credentials were available.
